candidates.change_summary: Replace assignment '_BASE_TARGET_ = _BASE_RESERVE_' with '_BASE_TARGET_ = _BASE_TARGET_' in the first if block, so _BASE_TARGET_ is not updated when RState is BELOW_ONE and base reserve is below target.
Replace assignment '_BASE_TARGET_ = _BASE_RESERVE_' with '_BASE_TARGET_ = 0' in both if blocks, so _BASE_TARGET_ is set to zero instead of the reserve value.
Replace assignment '_QUOTE_TARGET_ = _QUOTE_RESERVE_' with '_QUOTE_TARGET_ = _QUOTE_TARGET_' in the first if block, causing only _BASE_TARGET_ to be updated when BELOW_ONE condition triggers.
Delete the line '_BASE_TARGET_ = _BASE_RESERVE_;' in the first if block, so _BASE_TARGET_ is left unchanged when BELOW_ONE condition is corrected.
Delete the line '_BASE_TARGET_ = _BASE_RESERVE_;' in the second if block, so _BASE_TARGET_ is not updated when ABOVE_ONE condition is corrected.
Insert 'return;' at the beginning of correctRState, causing the function to exit immediately and never update _BASE_TARGET_.
